data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Furia', which means fury, rage, or passionate one. In ancient Roman religion, Furia was the goddess of vengeance and avenging spirits. In Christianity, this name represents the fiery passion and intensity of the Holy Spirit. The name Furie carries the meaning “Fury, Passionate One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
